nav.label: What we edit
nav.noDocuments: This version has no documents yet.

doc.notFoundTitle: There is no document "{{id}}" in this version
doc.notFoundLead: The link may be left over from another version. Pick a document on the left.

text.label: File text
text.empty: This document has no text files that can be edited here.
text.revertAsk: Restore the file to how it was when you opened it? Your edits will be lost.
text.typo: There is no field "{{wrong}}". Did you mean "{{right}}"?

released.title: Version {{version}} is released and does not change.
released.lead: Press "Edit a copy": your changes go into it.

signatures.lead: Drag a signature frame to where it belongs on the page. Everything is saved automatically.
signatures.hintFollow: Signatures that follow the text move together with it.
signatures.hintNoFollow: This PDF has no signature lines, so the signatures sit at their fallback places: move them.
signatures.failed: Could not build the PDF, so signatures cannot be placed on the page.
signatures.noPdfTitle: This document has no pages to place signatures on
signatures.noPdf: A document like this (for example, slides) is not built into a PDF. Signatures are added when it is signed.
signatures.notInKitTitle: This document is not part of the set for the chosen student conditions
signatures.notInKit: The student conditions come from the Result screen. Reset them to see the document page.
signatures.emptyLead: The "Signatures and places" section shows which signatures the version has.
signatures.frameNote: The frame shows how much room the signature takes. The real one may be a bit taller or shorter.
signatures.stale: The version was changed elsewhere, places are refreshed. Repeat your change.
signatures.others: Version signatures that are not in this document: {{count}}
signatures.own: Placed on page {{page}}. This place is only for this document.
signatures.sharedNote: This is the shared place: the signature stands here in every document without a place of its own.
signatures.missing: The signature is not visible in this PDF: the document text has no line for it.

follow.line: Follows the text: moves together with the signature line in the document.
follow.fallback: Follows the text, but this PDF has no signature line, so it sits at the fallback place.
follow.missing: Follows the text, but this PDF has no signature line.

signatures.makeSharedHint: This place becomes the shared one for every document where the signature has none of its own.
signatures.useSharedHint: This document will not have a place of its own: the signature goes to the shared place.
signatures.followHint: The signature is placed relative to a line in the text and stays with it if the text moves.
signatures.followOffHint: The signature stays where it is now.
signatures.dateMissing: This PDF has no line for the date.
signatures.dateLines: Put the date on a line:
signatures.exactBox: page {{page}}, {{x}} mm from the left edge, {{y}} mm from the top, {{width}} mm wide
signatures.commonText: on a line in the document text
signatures.commonLoader: The version does not set it, the standard one is used.

overview.lead: Which signatures the version's documents can have and where they stand. The "shared place" is one per signature: it applies in every document that has no place of its own. To change a place, open the document and go to "Signatures".
overview.emptyTitle: The version has no signatures yet
overview.emptyLead: Signatures are described in the version description. Once they appear, you will see here which documents they stand in.
overview.commonText: Shared place: on a line in the document text.
overview.noDocs: This signature does not belong to any document yet.
overview.order: Who signs and in what order is set in the section

leave: There are unsaved changes. Leave without saving them?
noDocumentsLead: Project data, questionnaires and deadlines are on the left.

legacy.noText: The document has no text files that can be edited here.
legacy.pickLead: Open a file in the tree on the left.
